audio_description:
A long-decked wooden ship rides the sea at sunset.
It spreads three enormous fan-shaped wings — the White SeeD Ship.
It glides toward the glowing sun.

context.scene_title: The White SeeD Ship — the wooden, fan-winged vessel of the White SeeDs, which intercepts Balamb Garden at sea (Disc 2).

characters.name: (White SeeDs, crew unseen)
characters.recognition: The ship itself is the subject — a medium wooden vessel with a long deck; no crew faces are shown.

context.summary: A long-decked wooden ship rides the sea at sunset, then spreads three enormous fan-shaped membrane wings/sails and glides across the water toward a glowing sun. This is the White SeeD Ship, the vessel of the White SeeDs who guard Ellone, shown intercepting/encountering the drifting Garden.
context.context_note: High confidence: the White SeeD Ship, confirmed by the Final Fantasy Wiki description of a wooden vessel with large wings at the back.
